entries.reason: Registry identity, generations and events now use a typed Protobuf schema while open-ended definition bodies use the shared lossless dynamic message.
entries.schema: definitions:registry version 2 is DefinitionRegistrySave with typed definition, generation and lifecycle event records.
entries.version: Binary and Protobuf JSON writers emit version 2. The hand-written version 1 schema remains only to validate legacy JSON imports.
entries.migration: Version 1 common envelopes are validated in a detached registry and recaptured as version 2 payloads; direct legacy JSON remains readable.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary restore rejects unknown Protobuf fields recursively; typed Protobuf JSON rejects unknown names, and legacy JSON uses its version 1 strict schema.
entries.restore_atomicity: The complete generation, definition and event image is validated in a detached VersionedRegistry state and published only after restoreState succeeds.

entries.reason: The registry offers Protobuf binary persistence alongside compatibility JSON and script APIs.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this persistence change.

entries.thread_affinity: Registry persistence runs on its owner thread and invokes no subscriber callbacks during restore.
cost_notes: Binary capture and restore cost linear time in retained definitions, events and body bytes per operation.
